_comment: F1.6. Which files the engine owns. Paths are as in this repo; globs use fnmatch, so * also crosses /. init-vault.py reads this file: it fills engine files with organisation values only, then writes a sha256 of each installed engine file to engine.lock at the vault root. engine-upgrade.py and lint (engine-drift) read the lock. Every other file in a vault belongs to the vault. Templates that init-vault.py places as vault content (its PLACE list) are not engine files.
_remapComment: Where an engine folder lands in a vault: [engine path, vault path]. P: = the private vault. Files that land in the private vault are not in the lock yet (shortcut: upgrade them by hand).
